dct_title_s: Edge of Pavement - City of Newton
dct_description_sm: Abstract: This data layer depicts the edge of Newton's paved roads, whether public or private. GIS data provided to Newton by Boston Edison Co. (now known as NSTAR).

Purpose: This layer is intended for researchers, students, and policy makers for reference and mapping purposes, and may be used for basic applications such as viewing, querying, and map output production. This layer will provide a basemap for layers related to urban planning or to support graphical overlays and analysis with other spatial data. More advanced user applications may focus on urban and transportation planning, public works, or utilities purposes, including defining boundaries, managing assets and facilities, integrating attribute databases with geographic features, spatial analysis, and presentation output.
Supplemental information: Newton has not been maintaining this data layer with any regularity
dct_rights_sm: Use constraints: For educational or non-commercial use only.
Access constraints: Access is granted to licensee (Harvard University) only. Available only to Harvard University affiliates.
Data credit: GIS data supplied by City of Newton GIS.
